answer.rationale: P99 latency spike during peak settlement traffic under a non-revertible security patch creates a constrained recovery problem. Rollback is ruled out by compliance. Regional failover (memory_b2) showed clean traffic shift and fast latency recovery during similar degradation. Pre-staged capacity provisioning (memory_b3) would take time and may not address the root latency cause. Circuit breaker (memory_b4) protects downstream but doesn't solve write-path latency. Read-replica routing (memory_b5) only helps read traffic. Failover isolates the degraded region, preserves all customer writes through shift to healthy capacity, and has proven recovery timeline in durable record. Verifying b2 and b3 to confirm failover success conditions and ensure we have sufficient healthy capacity to absorb peak settlement load post-shift.
